plan.title: docs: always-on writing bar (clarity, simplicity, brevity) for docs and communications

narratives.Description: Make clarity, simplicity, and brevity a standing writing bar for documents and user communications, including sub-agent status and handbacks. The #2927 STE depth page stays the how; the three words must live in always-on agents-entry so chat and workers see them without opening that page. The bar does not govern reasoning or thinking budgets.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Make **clarity, simplicity, and brevity** a product-wide standing writing bar for documents **and** user communications, including sub-agent status and handbacks.

Keep the #2927 STE four mechanics on the depth page. Put the three outcome words in always-on agent entry so the bar fires when no document is being written.

## Release highlight (operator 2026-08-14)

When this ships, call it out as a **highlighted item** in the release that contains it: the CHANGELOG `[<version>]` `>` blurb, the GitHub release *Key Changes*, and the Slack *Key Changes*. Do not bury it as an unmarked notes line.

## Decision (operator 2026-08-14)

- Outcome bar: Zinsser’s first three — **clarity, simplicity, brevity**.
- Keep STE how: short sentences, active voice, one term = one meaning, first-use definitions.
- Do **not** mark this `[AXIOM]`.
- Process MUST. Not a red CI style gate.
- Cut ceremony, not required fields.
- Product-content voice carve-out lives only on the depth page.
- Scope limit (operator 2026-08-14 body update): the bar does not govern reasoning itself. Thinking budgets are harness knobs (effort tier, per-role routing #1739), not prose rules. Do not extend the bar to thinking.

## Surfaces

1. `content/templates/agents-entry.md` — one `!` line with the three words inline; `agents_entry_contract` marker; `task agents:refresh`.
2. `content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md` — pointer-sufficient #3313-style section.
3. `content/docs/writing-ste100.md` — outcome bar + four STE mechanics + ceremony-vs-fields + product-content carve-out.
4. Replace the unmanaged maintainer AGENTS.md #2927 line; path stays `content/docs/writing-ste100.md`.

Full issue body is origin #3368.
narratives.UserStory: As an agent or maintainer, I want a standing clarity-simplicity-brevity bar in always-on entry, so that chat and handbacks stay short without opening a depth page.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Edit source file content/templates/agents-entry.md: replace the #2927 STE bullet with one standing ! line (clarity, simplicity, brevity inline; documents, user communications, sub-agent handbacks; cite .deft/core/docs/writing-ste100.md) and add an agents_entry_contract marker. Edit source file content/templates/agent-prompt-preamble.md: add a pointer-sufficient #3313-style section that names the three words. Edit source file content/docs/writing-ste100.md: name the outcome bar, keep the four STE mechanics, add ceremony-vs-fields plus product-content voice carve-outs, and state the bar does not govern reasoning. Edit source file AGENTS.md unmanaged header #2927 line with the same words and path content/docs/writing-ste100.md. Verify with task agents:refresh. CHANGELOG [Unreleased] ### Added is a highlighted bold entry citing #3368; the next release version blurb and Slack/GitHub Key Changes must name the writing bar. Evidence: task agents:refresh plus CHANGELOG #3368.

narrative.Acceptance: Given agents-entry.md after this lands, when it is read, one standing ! line contains clarity, simplicity, brevity inline, names documents, user communications, and sub-agent handbacks, cites .deft/core/docs/writing-ste100.md, includes ⊗ prefacing the rule, replaces the old #2927 STE bullet, is not labeled [AXIOM], and is covered by an agents_entry_contract marker. task agents:refresh updates the managed section.

Given a worker that never reopens AGENTS.md, when it reads the preamble, it sees the three words in a pointer-sufficient section. The unmanaged maintainer AGENTS.md #2927 line matches and cites content/docs/writing-ste100.md.

Given writing-ste100.md, when it is read, it names the three-word outcome bar, keeps the four STE mechanics, states cut-ceremony-not-required-fields, lists protocol fields that stay complete, states the product-content voice carve-out, and states the bar does not govern reasoning or thinking budgets. The always-on line does not mention those carve-outs. No red CI style gate is added.

Given this ships, when the next framework release is cut, CHANGELOG [Unreleased] has a highlighted ### Added bold entry citing #3368, and that release's version blurb plus GitHub/Slack Key Changes name the writing bar. It is not buried as an unmarked notes line.
